label: Buy Buttons
purpose: Add to cart button, with an optional secondary skip-cart buy-now button
_notes: atc_custom_label overrides the default 'Add to cart' label; if left empty the theme's default language string is used. display_price toggles showing the price inside the button. enable_secondary_btn adds a second, separate button (secondary_btn_label) that skips the cart and goes straight to checkout. Icon fields must be left as empty strings — images are filled in separately. show_dynamic_checkout, skip_cart, quantity-selector position, colors, sizes and spacing are all layout/integration settings and intentionally excluded.
